name: noorder_tie_wide_guard
purpose: Review of PR 661 (docs/mechanics/flow/5ga-residual-noorder-tie.md): Wide Guard is a side condition with a duration and no order (Speed 0, sub-order 4), an entry of the residual sort that the engine's list lacked. In the last step Machamp's Wide Guard stands on side 1, Politoed's Hypnosis stops Dragonite's locked turn and Venusaur restarts its lock, both at Speed 110; Perish Song ends side 1's two Pokemon. Without the Wide Guard entry the selection sort's swaps leave the two locks in the other pre-shuffle order (for every value of the draw), and the battle-ending faint point would come at the other lock. Refused on main and before the fix; PASS with the entry.
